recovered_contract: Per-account durable media archive with temporary staging.
WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, schema probes, transactions, checkpoints and per-account databases.
Uses content/external keys to prevent duplicates and find cached media.
Snaps, chat media, stories, voice notes, strangers and Discover, with per-friend rules.
Reconciles temporary/orphan media and prunes according to retention policy.
Exports to Photos, custom directories, clipboard/share and internal vault.
Downloads public Spotlight/story/profile media and imports it into archive.
Archives voice notes, supports upload/edit/background play and extends playback speeds.
Writes background image/video, caption and client ID; opens snapchat://creativekit preview/camera route.
Prepared media is referenced durably then handed to Snapchat public route.
